business_problem: Grupo Paolini is an Argentine family-owned corporate group with more than 60 years of history and 950 employees across four business lines: road construction, mining services, architecture, and agribusiness.
solution_summary: The group also faced a deeper structural risk. Senior employees who built the business over decades, many of them now over 65, carried critical operational knowledge that lived nowhere but in their heads. Preserving that knowledge while scaling the business pointed clearly toward Google Cloud and as the next frontier, as Google Workspace had already proven itself. At the center of this effort is Paolini IA (PIA), a customized AI assistant integrated into Google Workspace and deliberately designed as a grandmother figure to give employees a familiar, trustworthy entry point into AI. Gemini Enterprise gives every employee with a corporate account an always-available AI assistant embedded directly in the tools they already use daily. Managers now use a custom Gemini gem to calculate the ROI of improvement initiatives, asking the right questions, identifying hidden costs, and producing richer and more consistent reports.
